justifications.duplicates_removed: Duplicated flow records (double export) would bias the trained models and inflate accuracy.
justifications.missing_imputed: Median imputation for byte_std / flow_iat_mean - median is robust to the heavy right tail.
justifications.one_hot_encoding: 'protocol' is nominal (no order) -> one-hot avoids inventing a fake ordinal relationship.
justifications.log1p_transform: Byte/packet counts are right-skewed; log1p compresses extreme values toward normality.
justifications.standard_scaling: KNN, SVM and MLP need features on the same scale; fitted on train only (no leakage).
justifications.feature_selection: Mutual-information SelectKBest keeps the 12 most informative features (less noise, faster SVM).
justifications.stratified_split: 80/20 stratified split preserves the class imbalance in both train and test sets.
